device.description: 16-bit +/-18 V unbuffered voltage-output DAC with SPI interface, LDAC and selectable reset
device.note: dac8871.pdf (SBAS396A) p.1 description, p.3 digital inputs, p.4 power supply (VDD 2.7-5.5 V), p.5 pin configuration and terminal functions, p.6 Figures 1-2 timing, p.7 timing characteristics, p.15 power-on/hardware reset and serial interface

registers.name: IN
registers.note: input register; power-on/RST zero with RSTSEL low (p.15)

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: DAC latch; power-on/RST zero with RSTSEL low (p.15)

commands.name: Load input register
commands.note: p.15: CS low, SDI latched on SCLK rising MSB first; at CS rising the last 16 bits go to the input register

pages: p.1 (description), p.3 (logic levels), p.4 (VDD 2.7-5.5 V, VCC/VSS), p.5 (pinout, terminal functions), p.6 (Figures 1-2: SCLK low at CS falling, data on rising edges), p.7 (timing), p.14-15 (power-on and hardware reset, serial interface)
notModeled: analog: unbuffered +/-18 V voltage output, Kelvin reference inputs, VCC/VSS analog supplies
RSTSEL high: the datasheet sets the DAC latch to mid-scale at power-on and RST (p.15); the input register's reset value is not stated (0 here)
a frame of fewer than 16 bits corrupts the word; the model ignores frames shorter than 16 bits
power-supply sequencing (VCC/VSS before VDD before references)
variants: dac8871.pdf covers only the DAC8871 (S and SB grades)
